rationale: The agent called functions to look up the user and order, then executed an address modification. However, there is no evidence of user confirmation before performing the order-changing write, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. There is also no explicit verification that the order belongs to the authenticated user, nor any final confirmation or outcome message to the user. Additionally, the agent used a specific street address (123 Elm Street) without showing that it was obtained from the order details or confirmed. These gaps mean the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
